description_for_human: Live foreign exchange rates from the European Central Bank.
description_for_model: Use this plugin to convert one currency to another at the current ECB reference rate. Always show the original amount AND the converted amount with both currency codes. If the user gives a non-USD price, default to converting it to USD.

conversation_starters.text: How much is 500 euros in dollars?

functions.name: convert
functions.description: Convert an amount from one currency to another at the latest ECB rate.
